summary: Frontend-only mobile retest at 375x667 passed for visible income and expense deletion, internal cancel/confirm behavior, history deletion, balance refresh, and local persistence after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Delete controls have 44x44 touch targets and are wired on dashboard and history rows. Local storage usage is consistent with the local-only requirement.
seed_data_creation: Temporary income and expense records were created and deleted; no persistent seed data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: A first attempt encountered a Playwright viewport positioning error; the corrected run passed after scrolling each modal control into view. No app defect was observed.
rca_of_issue: No product issue reproduced. The initial automation failure was caused by tapping a modal control outside the mobile viewport without first scrolling it into view.
